text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: It's finally here! This year's spring Tenno Sho will begin shortly here at the verdant grounds of Kyoto Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The racer to look out for is, of course, Mejiro Bright, who has been making her formidable presence felt on the track!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: But will she be able to seize a consecutive win despite the fact that she'll have to run against her peer, Mejiro Dober?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Huh? Yeah, I'm fine… It's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clearly, it's not nothing… Something's been on her mind since the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Sorry. I know the race is about to start, but don't worry, I'll get my head back on straight.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (She only has eyes for the race!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: That just gave me chills… She's so determined…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: (She's putting everything on the line for this race!)
